Image: Lisa Fisher Photography – Vet Services Hawkes Bay Hastings -Web Social Media-13 ## Natalie Murtagh  Clinic Manager Nat is focussed to develop the team in their professional growth and to build a culture that complements the business, and the community in what we do and provide.   Great customer service is of the utmost importance when it comes to running and growing a business and Nat is excited about being able to deliver this to our existing and ever growing client base and getting to know them all. Nat and her partner Jase, Coco the Löwchen and Casper the Lhasa Apso dogs enjoy a more relaxed life now that their adult children are off exploring the world and can often be found tramping the rivers and fishing for trout when their busy schedules allow.   Image ## Marit De Jong Companion Animal team leader  Marit joined Vet Services as our Companion Animal Clinic Manager in early 2023. Originally from the Netherlands, Marit moved to Napier in the early ‘90s. She spent her high school years working towards her goal of becoming a veterinarian and graduated from Massey University in 2005. Marit’s career began in a rural practice located in Southern Taranaki and spent stints working as a mixed practice veterinarian in Raetihi and Matamata before moving back to Hawkes Bay to be closer to family. In recent years, Marit decided to focus on companion animal  medicine. She really enjoys the challenge of doing clinical work and leading her team of vets and nurses. Outside of work, Marit is a busy mum of two children aged 10 and 12, a Thai Ridgeback and two SPCA cats who hare causing her hair to go grey (just joking – that is her husband’s fault).
